descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Luxury Wine Product Photograph for CHÂTEAU MARBÉROT 2018 Bordeaux release campaign. Subject: 750ml dark-olive Bordeaux bottle filled with deep-claret liquid #4A1420, half-peeled gold-foil capsule #C9A96A curling 42° revealing cork neck, printed label 'CHÂTEAU MARBÉROT 2018' 6pt Didot serif centred, pulled natural cork resting 18° beside bottle showing stain line, empty crystal Bordeaux glass camera-right catching single claret drop. Setting: dark oak plank #3A2818 horizontal grain. Composition: Rule of Thirds bottle on left vertical 33% x, Centered 50% y, Eye-Level 0° slight 4° tilt, Leading Lines of plank grain, bottle 64% of frame. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 120mm LS Macro at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 6 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-right 45° elevation 1.5m (key), 1×4ft strip rim camera-left 30° grazing bottle shoulder 1.1m (rim), 4×4ft white bounce below 0.6m (label fill), 4×4ft black flag overhead to deepen oak. Material physics: glass thickness refraction, claret liquid meniscus, gold-foil crinkle specular, cork pore texture, oak pore absorption. Color grade: Capture One Warm-18 LUT grain 7 +0.1 EV. Palette: claret 46%, dark oak 28%, gold foil 14%, cork tan 8%, glass highlight 4%. References: Irving Penn still life, Peter Lippmann Ruinart, Decanter cover. Exclude: spill splashes, flat lighting, plastic reflection, fingerprints, colour cast.
